title: Lin Dong Wins the Clan Competition
summary: Lin Dong floors Lin Shan with a seven-ring Tong Bei Fist, and Lin Hong steps in, mocks the family and says he will win the clan competition and claim Qing Tan as his wife. Lin Xiao sees his son's progress and teaches him the Eight Desolation Palm. When Qing Tan's cold poison flares, the Stone Talisman absorbs the cold and condenses it into a bead. At the competition Lin Hong beats Qing Tan and is about to be named winner when Lin Dong arrives and challenges him. Lin Dong shows a ten-ring Tong Bei Fist, a better Eight Desolation Palm and Tempered Body 7th layer, and wins. The elders then plan for the Hunting Battle against the Lei and Xie families, while Lei Bao boasts that his son Lei Li has reached Earthly Yuan.
events: Lin Dong beats Lin Shan with a seven-ring Tong Bei Fist.
Lin Hong mocks Lin Xiao and says he will win Qing Tan at the clan competition.
Lin Xiao teaches Lin Dong the 2nd-grade Eight Desolation Palm.
The Stone Talisman draws out Qing Tan's cold poison and condenses it into a bead; she keeps the secret.
Lin Dong reaches Tempered Body 6th layer and arrives late to the competition.
Lin Hong defeats Qing Tan; Lin Dong challenges him and wins at Tempered Body 7th layer.
The elders choose Lin Dong for the Hunting Battle against the allied Lei and Xie families.
Lei Bao and Lei Li, now at Earthly Yuan, plan to crush him.
cultivation: Lin Dong reaches Tempered Body 6th layer and reveals Tempered Body 7th layer in the final. Lin Hong is at Tempered Body 7th layer. Lei Li has reached Earthly Yuan.
